extDescription.message: Open links, images and selected text in a new tab by click & drag – the drag direction decides foreground or background.

actionTitleOn.message: HSLinkDrag is on – click to turn off

actionTitleOff.message: HSLinkDrag is off – click to turn on

hintAccess.message: Firefox has not allowed HSLinkDrag to access websites – without it the drag gesture cannot be detected on any page. HSLinkDrag does not read page content and transmits nothing.

hintEnabled.message: Main switch. You can also toggle it by clicking the toolbar icon; when off, the icon turns grey. If the icon is missing, find it in the Extensions menu (puzzle piece) and pin it to the toolbar.

hintDirection.message: Press the mouse button on a link, an image, an SVG graphic or selected text, drag left or right and release. Foreground shows the new tab right away; background loads it quietly and you stay on the current page. Press ESC while dragging to cancel.

hintPosition.message: Where the new tab is inserted in the tab strip. Several tabs opened one after another to the right line up in the order you opened them. If the current tab is in a tab group, the new tab joins that group (except “At the end”).

hintImageLink.message: When a link sits on an image or SVG graphic, dragging without SHIFT opens what you choose here. Hold SHIFT while releasing to open the other one instead.

hintText.message: Dragging selected text searches for it with the chosen search engine. If the text is a web address (e.g. “www.example.com” or “example.org/page”), it is opened directly. An email address opens your email client – no tab is opened and the direction does not matter.

hintMinDistance.message: How far the mouse has to move left or right before anything happens. Shorter movements are ignored to prevent accidental opening.

hintShowOverlay.message: Shows next to the mouse pointer what will happen on release, e.g. “→ Foreground · Link”. “↔” means: not dragged far enough yet.

hintExcluded.message: One domain per line, e.g. “trello.com”. HSLinkDrag stays inactive on these sites and their subdomains – useful for sites with their own drag & drop such as kanban boards or cloud storage.

viewerMissing.message: This graphic is no longer available. SVG graphics opened by dragging are only kept until the browser restarts.

footerLimits.message: Note: Firefox does not allow extensions on its own pages (about:…, New Tab, addons.mozilla.org), in Reader View or in the built-in PDF viewer. Extensions may not open links or images pointing to local files (file://…) in Firefox. In private windows HSLinkDrag only runs if you allow “Run in Private Windows” in the Add-ons Manager.
